items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: he found a very fine teacher. I always think he's one of the finest, Mr. P. B. Langford.

ctx.x: So, he got this band together. I think I must have been, Stan, well, around 8 years old and he found a very fine teacher. I always think he's one of the finest, Mr. P. B. Langford.
